properties.disease overview: Injury to knee stabilizing ligaments (ACL, PCL, MCL, LCL) causing instability; key mechanisms include pivot injury for ACL and posterior tibial translation for PCL.
properties.mechanism: ACL: rapid deceleration/pivot with valgus/rotation; PCL: posteriorly directed force on proximal tibia (dashboard injury); MCL/LCL: valgus/varus stress; severe injury/dislocation can endanger the popliteal artery.
